claims.sentence: Male Wistar rats (n=30) were divided into five groups: control rats (NS group), rats given 3 g of fish oil (NS+FO3 group), rats injected with streptozotocin-lipopolysaccharide (STZ-LPS) (STZ-LPS group), rats injected with STZ-LPS and given 1 g/kg of fish oil (STZ-LPS+FO1 group), and rats injected with STZ-LPS and given 3 g/kg of fish oil (STZ-LPS+FO3 group).
